title: malus × purpurea f. lemoinei
intro: Malus × purpurea f. lemoinei, commonly known as Purple Crabapple, is a specific cultivar of the crabapple tree, known for its deep purple flowers and fruit. The Purple Crabapple is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Malus × purpurea f. lemoinei are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
